Objects assets/colors/dimensions/mass/base poses unchanged within family. Actual setup role changes robot pose and held object, recorded.

physical_validity: Retain every setup failure, actual success/failure/refusal. Score intended/all rows plus actually valid pairs. No root replacement after admission. Pilot first A/B train family; require at least one real valid matched pair in each environment to proceed. No selective exclusion from training.
old_negative: Prior20-to40 scaling negative remains evidence; this is a finite role-confounding hypothesis test, not erasure of earlier failure.
